title: The Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the rare ’82 Dew show, highlighted by a smoking Not Fade Away and a strong second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crisp, well‑balanced soundboard mix, though one listener notes the tape runs slightly fast. Musically the concert shines – the first set is solid and the second set is especially strong, with Brent’s B3 on Not Fade Away standing out and Jerry’s vocals still full of nuance despite occasional fatigue.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.2; most comments are enthusiastic about both performance and audio quality, with only minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑blended mix noted by several reviewers; one comment mentions the recording sounds sped‑up, but overall balance and clarity are praised.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is solid; second set receives special praise for its energy and tight playing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals are strong and expressive, though a few reviewers note he sounds a bit tired at times.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s B3 on Not Fade Away adds a bright kick; his playing is described as experimental and fun.
